metadata.policy: Use quoted PDG 2024 summary values; do not multiply quoted uncertainties by scale factors. Each shared resonance total width is stored once. Branching fractions and total widths are summary quantities and are not assumed jointly independent.
metadata.covariance: No complete joint covariance across the selected channels, total widths, and gamma-gamma partial widths is encoded. Treating quoted summaries as diagonal inputs is conditional; PDG constrained-fit summaries have internal overlap and published fit correlations that are not propagated here.
metadata.rho_nwa: The rho is broad. Quoted rho branching fractions and total widths refer to PDG listing conventions; mapping them to a narrow-width on-shell tensor amplitude is a model approximation, not a precision line-shape treatment.
metadata.pi0_policy: Use the PDG-cited direct PrimEx partial-width measurement Γ(pi0→γγ)=7.802±0.052(stat)±0.105(syst) eV, combining the two quoted errors in quadrature. Do not also use the PDG mean-life average or multiply by a gamma-gamma branching fraction; that would reuse the same width information.
excluded_inputs: η′→ρ0γ inclusive branching fraction because it includes non-resonant π+π−γ and the PDG resonant component is model-fit dependent

deferred.reason: The PDG 2024 inclusive η′→ρ0γ entry includes non-resonant π+π−γ. The separate resonant fraction is not published as a model-independent average; the listed values come from fits with differing ρ/ω/box-anomaly or ρ(1450) components. The current narrow-width predictor does not model that inclusive background.
